I’m extremely disappointed with my experience at this Petco grooming location and would not recommend them.

I brought my dogs in and was told that a portion of his ear was matted and that if they attempted to cut or shave it, he could develop a hematoma and I may end up having to take him to the emergency room. The way this was communicated felt unnecessarily alarming and made it sound as though something was likely to happen to my dog if they proceeded. When I asked whether they simply did not feel comfortable grooming him, I was met with an attitude and told that it wasn’t about them being uncomfortable.

At that point, I decided not to leave my dog there. If the groomers did not want to perform the service or did not feel they could safely handle that small area of his ear, I would have much rather they simply communicated that clearly and professionally instead of making me feel like I was putting my dog at risk by having him groomed.

What made the situation even more frustrating is that I have taken my dogs to the Petco location on Kuykendahl when they were more matted than this, and I have always had an excellent experience. The staff there have consistently been kind, professional, helpful, and reassuring. After leaving this location, I called Kuykendahl, explained exactly what had happened, and they were incredibly accommodating. They were able to get my dogs in that same day (today) and schedule their grooming appointment without making me feel fearful or uncomfortable and did an amazing job.

I also recently discovered another issue with this location. For months, I had been unable to schedule grooming appointments through the Petco app because I kept receiving an error message. I finally went into this location on FM 1960 and explained the problem. I was told that the app issue had “been happening to everyone.” I later learned from the Kuykendahl location that I had actually been blocked from scheduling grooming appointments through the app.

What is especially confusing is that I have never even had my dogs groomed at this location. I have canceled appointments with them in the past because I occasionally confused this location with the Kuykendahl location given that they’re close by but blocking me from booking through the app entirely without ever communicating that to me was incredibly unprofessional and I have NEVER EVEN taken them here. Even worse, when I specifically asked about the error, I was given an explanation that apparently was not true.

Thankfully, the staff at Kuykendahl took the time to help me, explain what had happened, and remove the block so I could schedule appointments again.

The difference in customer service between these two locations is honestly night and day. I understand that groomers have to make decisions based on an animal’s safety, and I would never expect someone to perform a service they genuinely believe is unsafe. My issue is with the way everything was handled and communicated. There was no need for the attitude, the fear-inducing explanation, or the lack of transparency regarding my account.

If this location did not want to groom my dogs, they could have simply said so. Based on my experiences, I will continue taking my dogs to the Kuykendahl location, where the staff have always treated both me and my dogs with kindness and professionalism. I would not recommend the FM 1960 location for grooming.

I needed some very specific food for my fur babies.  I was not excited about going to Petco however when I got there, everyone was willing to help and showing me where everything was and answering questions about the food and which was the best one.

This is a sales-driven branch that shows absolutely no regard for customer satisfaction. The store manager used accusatory language instead of resolving the issue I was facing. I am completely done with this company, even though I had purchased products from them 18 times in the past year. My advice to the owner of Petco is to be more selective when hiring store managers and staff—specifically, to choose animal lovers or pet owners who can empathize with the feelings of other pet owners. Zero empathy and robotic responses; it was truly a terrible experience for me.

I am extremely disappointed and upset by my experience at this Petco location.

Over the past year, I have made a total of 13 purchases from Petco: 8 online orders and 5 in-store purchases. I have consistently bought premium and diet-specific dog food for my two large dogs, and I have spent a significant amount of money here because I trusted this store.

On May 23, I purchased another bag of Taste of the Wild dog food. I did not open it immediately because my previous food was not finished. I began using it only after the previous food ran out, approximately 4–5 days ago.

From the moment my dogs started eating this food, both of them developed diarrhea. I initially assumed it was due to the dietary transition and continued feeding it.

Today, while serving the food, I discovered a large live worm/larva inside the kibble. I immediately documented it with video and brought the product, the remaining food, and the bag back to the store.

Instead of receiving support or a proper investigation, I was treated with strong suspicion, as if I had already used most of the product and returned it only to obtain a replacement. This implication felt extremely disrespectful and deeply upsetting, especially given my purchase history.

I felt like my honesty and integrity as a customer were being questioned without justification.

In frustration and distress after this interaction, I poured the remaining food outside near the store entrance area as a form of protest.

During this incident, a store employee began recording me on video without my consent. I did not agree to being filmed, and this made the situation even more uncomfortable and distressing for me.

I came to this store as a paying, repeat customer with a legitimate concern about a potentially contaminated product affecting my dogs’ health. Instead of understanding or resolution, I was met with suspicion and treated unfairly.

This experience has seriously damaged my trust in this store and how customer concerns are handled.

Do yourself a major favor and go see Rome!

He was incredibly positive, welcoming, and genuinely enthusiastic about helping customers. I had stopped in to pick up some snails for my aquarium, and instead of rushing through the transaction, he took the time to explain Petco’s Vital Care program and how it works for all kinds of pets - not just cats and dogs, but reptiles, fish, birds, and even small pets too.

Rome was super knowledgeable and broke everything down in a way that was easy to understand. It never felt like a sales pitch, more like someone who actually cares about making sure pet owners know about resources that could really help them save money and take better care of their animals. His attitude was upbeat, friendly, and professional the entire time.

If you’re visiting this location, definitely look for Rome - you’ll be glad you did! 🐠

My wife and I brought my dogs to the store to buy their dog food like I always do and unfortunately went when they were doing dog training.  One of the Petco trainers had a very large and aggressive dog at the front of the store and didn't appear to have the dog under control.  I was trying to check out while this aggressive dog barked and lunged for my dogs.  I stayed back and asked them to move their dog away from the front of the store but he ignored my requests.  The Petco trainer had the audacity to tell us to leave and go around him.   The cashier didn't help and we finally asked for a manager.  The manager came out and did nothing.  After roughly five minutes the man finally moved the dog away from the front so we could leave.  We left our cart full of stuff near the checkout and left while it was safe to do so.  We have never been treated so poorly and we will not be going back to a Petco store again after this horrible experience.  We proceeded to drive past another Petco store that we shopped at previously and now we will shop at Petsmart even though it's further from us.
